answer: One concrete defense is bonded staking: each agent posts refundable collateral before it can transact, so spinning up a thousand fake identities costs real capital. Funnel value through a single narrow inlet rather than an open flood, where every newcomer must stake at the gate and provable misbehavior burns that stake. A sybil swarm then bends like a willow under the cost, while an honest agent, whose credential is marked violet by peer attestation, passes cheaply and later reclaims its bond.
